NFL games are primarily played in the United States at each team's home stadium, but the league also hosts games internationally through the NFL International Series, which began in 2007 with Wembley Stadium in London as the first location [d1][d4]. Through the 2024 season, the NFL has played 36 regular season games in London, four in Mexico City, and three across Germany [d6]. In 2024 specifically, international games were held at Corinthians Arena in Brazil, Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and Wembley Stadium in the United Kingdom, and Allianz Arena in Germany [d7]. Looking ahead, the NFL will also play a regular-season game in Madrid, Spain, during the 2025 season [d2], and on rare occasions games have been played at neutral domestic venues as well [d9].
